_comment: Trae IDE hooks.json template. Trae schema: { version:1, hooks:{ <Event>:[{ matcher?, loop_limit?, hooks:[{ type:'command', command, timeout }] }] } }. timeout is in SECONDS (not ms). Trae does NOT interpolate ${VAR} in command strings — the installer (scripts/install-trae.js) rewrites ${TRAE_PLUGIN_ROOT} to an absolute path before laying this file into ~/.trae-cn/hooks.json. Trae supports 6 events: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, Notification. caveman-trae wires 5 (Notification omitted — async, unrelated to compression). Trae tool names differ from Claude (e.g. Terminal/RunCommand vs Bash, File System vs Write); matchers below cover both naming families.
